    Last updated on 2026-11-24 | Edit this page

    Estimated time: 25 minutes

    Overview

    Questions

    • What can I access, and who can help?
    • [TODO (co-design): add a question]
    • [TODO (co-design): add a question]

    Objectives

    • Identify the main routes to computing and AI tools: institutional, national, commercial and international.
    • Explain how eligibility affects which routes are open to you.
    • Identify specialists who can help, such as research software engineers and data services.

    Introduction

    Callout

    What participants told us

    At the community workshop in Oxford on 12 November 2026, arts and humanities researchers, data services and support staff voted on the challenges that limit their use of AI. This episode responds to:

    • C2 Don’t know what tools or computing are available or how to get them (7 votes)
    • No institutional affiliation or short-term contracts (2 votes)
    • S2 No specialist to work with (3 votes)
